<Activity x:Class="MonitorEvents" xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/netfx/2009/xaml/activities" xmlns:ui="http://schemas.uipath.com/workflow/activities" xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml">
  <ui:MonitorEvents ContinueOnError="{x:Null}" RepeatForever="True">
    <ui:MonitorEvents.Handler>
      <ActivityAction x:TypeArguments="x:Object">
        <ActivityAction.Argument>
          <DelegateInArgument x:TypeArguments="x:Object" Name="args" />
        </ActivityAction.Argument>
        <Sequence DisplayName="イベント ハンドラー" />
      </ActivityAction>
    </ui:MonitorEvents.Handler>
  </ui:MonitorEvents>
</Activity>
